outcome: Inspection trusts a run only after verifying its snapshots, evidence, and recomputed results.

dependencies.requires: Published run format and app API

interfaces: Replay resolves snapshots and evidence only inside the run after symlink resolution; never dereference original evidence paths.
Verify complete one-to-one source/index/original/path/digest bindings and report source rewrites.
App reruns the exact validation/evaluation path; structural/status/count differences are exact, finite result tolerance is fixed.
acceptance_criteria: Relocation succeeds with original sources unavailable; damaged snapshots/evidence and inconsistent stored results fail.
inspect only accepts selected episode IDs and returns full opaque input, expected/original/final prediction and configuration.
Opaque large integers preserved; no internal evaluator API accepts unvalidated replay JSON.

verification.expected: Successful inspection without original evidence and unchanged large integer.
Missing/extra/swapped bindings, hash damage, escaping symlinks, result tampering rejected.

verification_responsibility: A different agent from the implementation author reruns evidence and reviews every acceptance criterion; integrator accepts only the saved response.
common_completion_checks: All listed artifacts contain implemented behavior or required evidence; no placeholders.

All tests assigned to this task are listed by Cargo and execute with a nonzero expected test count. Compound conformance/structure cases have explicit later audit test owners in coverage.json; implementers still test each local invariant now.
Relevant fmt/Clippy/test/build checks pass on the pinned toolchain; no bypass, changed tolerance or weakened oracle.
Saved response records exact input/source/output hashes, commands, exit codes, expected/actual results, and unresolved failures.
New or changed-authority artifacts are indexed; operational state is updated in Fizzy after acceptance.
